newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Zedillo to visit Japan March 10-14.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Zedillo to visit Japan March 10-14.

text.p: Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo will visit Japan March 10-14 in an effort to boost bilateral trade and political ties, the Mexican Foreign Ministry said on Monday.

The ministry said in a news release the two countries would reach "important accords on economic and financial cooperation," as well as scientific, technical and educational agreements, during Zedillo's visit.
Zedillo will follow up on accords reached in August during Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto's trip to Mexico, the ministry said. The two leaders have a working meeting planned.
Zedillo's schedule also calls for an interview with Emperor Akihito.
The Mexican president will stop in Tokyo, Nagoya, Kyoto and Osaka, meeting with local officials, business people and intellectuals along the way, the foreign ministry said.
